items.title: Praana, Live in Concert
items.programme: Live concert with food festival and cultural show
items.description: Chathurya was one of the featured artists at Praana, a live concert presented by Show Bees at the NLDB farm premises by Weerawila Lake in Tissamaharama. She shared the stage with Umara Sinhawansa, her coach on The Voice Sri Lanka, along with Peshala Ridhma, Sanka, Piyath, Samanalee Fonseka and Indrachapa. The evening combined the concert with a food festival and cultural show, including a dance performance by Nirosha Thalagala.

items.description: A Valentine's season concert at Gatambe Grounds, Kandy, organised by MindSpark with Shaa FM as media partner. Chathurya sang alongside Centigradz and Shashika Nisansala, with the band Arrow Star and a guest appearance by Podi Malli and Chooty Malli.
